summary: Listed /data, inspected the starts of gps.json and locations.json, and scanned time_logs.csv for 'Rafał'. Located a time_log entry showing Rafał was found in Gdańsk on 2019-01-10 (so you should arrive 2019-01-09).
lesson: Avoid dumping whole large files (outputs were truncated); use targeted commands (grep, head, awk, sed, or jq) to extract relevant lines. If python3 is unavailable, rely on standard shell tools (awk/sed/grep) or install/use an available interpreter. Cross-reference location_id between time_logs, locations.json and gps.json rather than printing entire files.
